analysis: TNF opener: Cowboys -9.5, total 47.5 (DraftKings and bet365 agree); Dallas team total 29.5 (-110). The number moved from a look-ahead of DAL -3.5 after Baker Mayfield dislocated his throwing thumb; UDFA rookie Jalon Daniels starts again (Tampa scored 14 with him in Week 4). With Mayfield priced at -5.5, the sim has Dallas by 10.3, so the spread is fairly priced.

CORRECTION 10/5: the earlier Over 47.5 lean read the injury-blind total (50.5). With the rookie QB priced in, the sim projects 45.0 (over only 43%) -- Tampa 17.3, Dallas 27.7. Real 2026 scoring lands in the same place once the Mayfield games are discounted. Dallas team total 29.5 sits about 2 points above both projections. No total bet; wait for TNF player props.
